label: prf:jet-prolongation
title: Proof of Jet Prolongation
html:
Proof. Proof of Jet Prolongation

The proof proceeds in the rigid monoidal category underlying the quantum observable universe. Let A denote the Frobenius--Hopf object representing the gauge-bundle data of (\mathbf{C}, \varTheta, G, \mathcal{S}).

By (categorical jet object inherits Frobenius--Hopf structure), J^1(A) := A \otimes \Omega^1(A) is an object of the ambient category and inherits the Frobenius--Hopf data (\Delta', \varepsilon', S') from A.

Non-degeneracy and vanishing. The non-degeneracy of the Frobenius form on A (the pairing \varepsilon \circ m is a perfect pairing) implies non-degeneracy of the induced form on J^1(A), since \Omega^1(A) is a direct summand. For the vanishing condition, \mathrm{Hom}(\mathbf{1}, \mathrm{Ad}(A)) = 0 implies \mathrm{Hom}(\mathbf{1}, \mathrm{Ad}(J^1(A))) = 0: the adjoint representation of J^1(A) contains \mathrm{Ad}(A) as a subobject, and any invariant in \mathrm{Ad}(J^1(A)) would project to a non-zero invariant in \mathrm{Ad}(A), contradicting the hypothesis.

Geometric realisation. Applying the fibre functor \tau\colon \mathbf{C} \to \mathrm{Vect}_k recovers the geometric data: \tau(J^1(A)) is the space of sections of the first jet bundle J^1 \mathcal{S}, the frame bundle P' and orthonormal frame bundle \mathcal{S}' are the geometric counterparts of the Frobenius--Hopf structure on J^1(A), and the connection A' is the image under \tau of the comultiplication \Delta'. Its uniqueness follows from the irreducibility of A', which is guaranteed by the inherited vanishing condition. \square
